issuer.summary: A disclosed Panama operator provides a point of contractual accountability, but underlying fund/custodian brands and trading-team credentials do not establish wrapper title or token repayment protection. Retain distinct legacy token issuer marks provisionally; their old prestige-based difference is not freshly validated. thBILL requires KYC/KYB, returns stablecoins and denies claims on underlying fund units. thUSD is separate from yield-bearing sthUSD; staking queues must not be assigned to the base token. Gold leasing/futures risks and insurance claims are not proof of complete backing.
